active_location.macro_silhouette: The exterior vista of The First Forge stood as a jagged silhouette of brass and basalt against the screaming Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear. Arcs of violent purple lightning crawled across the reinforced bulkheads, illuminating the ferrofluid sea below in rhythmic, terrifying bursts. The atmospheric pressure warped the very air, turning the horizon into a smeared painting of raw exoplanet fury.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Violet lightning and shifting obsidian ferrofluid
sensory_palette.sound: Deafening, rhythmic roaring of magnetic shear

interactive_features.affordance_description: Massive brass plates designed to deflect stray arcs
A raw, charged geode humming with potential
Heavy valves to redirect the rising black tide

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: Equilibrate the planetary magnetic field by force
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: The outer struts of the Forge are beginning to resonate dangerously

three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: Understanding this wave is key to predicting the exoplanet's climate.

narrative_prose: Silas wiped grease from his forehead, adjusting his heavy goggles as the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear screamed across the ferrofluid sea. The shimmering expanse danced with volatile energy, throwing violet shadows against the basalt walls of The First Forge. 'Inefficient,' he grumbled, watching the waves crest. The structural supports were groaning under the pressure. He gripped the iron spanner tight, finding a familiar rhythm as he reinforced the primary struts. When he turned, the air crackled. He tossed the spanner, end over end, straight at Hector's chest. 'Your turn, Stormbreaker. Don't melt it.'
